product_scope: Google My Drive and Shared Drive connections on Linux, with on-demand reads, offline pins and opt-in ordinary-file writes. Native Google Docs and Sheets are mounted as read-only export packages in this release candidate.

requirements.summary: My Drive metadata and ordinary bytes are readable through the shared mounted filesystem.
Opt-in ordinary-file creates, saves, atomic replacements, renames, moves and recoverable removals work through a mounted My Drive.
Two simultaneous Google accounts remain independently mounted, readable and writable.
A selected Shared Drive supports scoped discovery, refresh, ordinary reads and explicitly granted ordinary-file writes.
Native Docs and Sheets expose bounded, read-only DOCX/PDF/ODT and XLSX/PDF/ODS export packages through the mount.
Official packages contain the Cirrove Desktop OAuth registration and need no per-user client JSON.
Google Auth Platform has saved both drive.readonly and full drive scopes used by the two connection modes.
Provider-neutral Files and Dolphin surfaces expose Google mount state and offline pin controls.

The 0.2.0 support boundary is explicitly approved: native Docs/Sheets stay read-only, restricted Shared Drive roles remain unclaimed, resource-key shortcuts stay browser links and Google changes use polling.
requirements.next_action: Obtain the owner's explicit approval of this documented 0.2.0 boundary or implement the rejected portions before release.

requirements.summary: A reviewed homepage, privacy policy, removal page and terms URL are public on an operator-controlled verified domain.
requirements.next_action: Supply the operator domain, legal identity, public contact, any required address and policy approval; publish the site and run scripts/check-oauth-site.py --release.

requirements.summary: Google has approved the public branding and restricted Drive scopes for users outside the test list.
requirements.next_action: After the public site is configured, record the end-to-end demonstration, submit verification and retain Google's decision without exposing account or credential data.

requirements.summary: The exact 0.2.0 release artifacts complete Google sign-in and a bounded mounted read on a clean supported desktop without a custom JSON file.
requirements.next_action: Build the 0.2.0 release candidate, install its packages in a clean supported VM and complete one owner-driven browser sign-in followed by an exact mounted read.

requirements.summary: Version 0.2.0 is tagged, packaged, attested, published and installed from the published artifacts.
requirements.next_action: After every preceding blocking gate closes, follow docs/release-procedure.md for v0.2.0 and verify the downloaded artifacts and installation.

requirements.summary: Reader, commenter, contributor and content-manager Shared Drive roles have their own live acceptance matrix.
requirements.rationale: The current release claims one selected drive with permissions Google grants; it does not claim that every restricted role can write. One administrator-owned drive has live evidence, and the UI reports provider permission failures.

requirements.summary: Exported native Google documents can be edited locally and written back without losing concurrent Google edits.
requirements.rationale: The candidate explicitly presents native documents as read-only export packages. The Drive media-import conflict probe changed content despite HTTP 412, so enabling that path would violate Cirrove's conflict-preservation contract.
